National victims tell L nothing. Watch pool each press conference; if it nears 1000 reduce kills of victims whose reports are in reachable single places. Kills day1: 10 quick + 1 timed.

Day2 plan: 9 kills (national d2-5 + 2 each from regional:West, cable, forum, foreign). Blotter spared (d2-7, d2-8). Reason: L can reach only 3 of my 5 places (one per kind). Killing in 4 places leaves about a 60% chance that at most 2 reachable places are ever in my kills. Blotter is spared because its 0.2 factor drops the pool most. Pool model: baseline 35000 (the announced 40000 is rounded). Each place that reaches 3 successful traces multiplies the pool by about 0.25 (blotter 0.2). One activation shows about 9000, two show about 2000, three means I am caught at that day's end. Never allow a third activation. Rules: if pool shows about 9000 or lower after a day, keep the same 4 places but do not add any. If pool shows about 2000 (two activations, which places unknown), stop non-national kills and kill only the national victim each day, which tells L nothing. Keep routine as is: quick kills in morning and afternoon, timed kills rare and only in evening or night. Day 3 target: 9 kills, same places, if pool is still above 5000.
